name: Flat Class of $U_{1,2}$
definition: $\mathcal H_{U_{1,2}}=\{00,11\}$, the indicator vectors of the two flats $\varnothing$ and $\{1,2\}$ of the rank-one uniform matroid.
properties: It is a matroid flat class with VC dimension, Yang dimension, and interpolation degree one. Its one-inclusion graph has two isolated vertices, so it is not a partial cube. Conditioning the first coordinate to zero gives $\{0\}$ on the remaining one-coordinate domain, which cannot be a complete flat family because every matroid ground set is itself a flat.
